description: By now many of you have seen the mailers, TV ads and texts. They claim my campaign is funded by anti-abortion money, and they call me MAGA. Neither is true. Every dollar my campaign has raised is public record with the Washington Public Disclosure Commission. Anyone can look it up at pdc.wa.gov, and I’d encourage you to. The money my campaign is spending is being used to tell you who I am and how I will serve you– not to harm my opponent.So who is paying for these attack ads? A political committ
